summary: RECOVERY-FINISH of the beat-free tube representation build (3rd launch). The implementation is substantially complete in the working tree (coder ckpt 980f7e3d) and VERIFIED by survey: the tube chart stores a beat-free residual r(w)=E(w)/F_ref(w) via a single authoritative helper `_tube_f_ref` (surrogate.py ~2953); the build side (`surrogate_training._build_tube_chart` ~3046) stores E/F_ref and refuses+zero-fills a node whose reference is None (never defaults F_ref to 1); the serve side (`_evaluate_chart` ~3630) re-modulates E=r*F_ref at the RAW eigenframe source; `_tube_serves` (~3130) probes the SAME `_tube_f_ref` at the raw source over the chart w-grid as a buildability gate; the `TUBE_BEAT_FREE_AIRY='tube_beat_free_airy_v1'` envelope-definition tag + stale-artifact hard-refusal are live. The dead delay-map/TV-axis symbols are confirmed ABSENT (the s'/TV graduation axis was correctly not carried). Two concrete gaps remain from the first launch's death (test-dev max-turns at Inspector rev1 with 2 impl + 1 design findings, never recorded): (1) an ORPHAN test file `test_lensing_tube_nyquist_coordinate.py` imports the dead graduation-era symbols and breaks pytest collection; (2) the beat-free suite has four-band buildability SMOKE tests but NO F083 eps-accuracy held-out test (it explicitly says its buildability test is 'NOT the eps accuracy sweep'), and the F083 falsification RUN result (nodes, eps) is still not on record. This plan is a re-scope to FINISH, not rewrite: ONE Coder WP audits/closes the unrecorded impl findings (Professor's highest-risk target: the tau_c=virtual_delay-t_min frame cancellation must be applied identically to both the E and F_ref legs — a constant offset round-trips at nodes but LEAKS off-node, exactly what F083 catches) and deletes the orphan; all NEW test authoring goes to the Test Developer (F083 eps-accuracy test, a RAW-source spy pin, and repointing the D2-fold suite only if it drifted). ASSUMPTION: the working tree at 980f7e3d is intact and on branch claude-dev. ACCEPTANCE the Coder cannot self-satisfy: the Test-Developer-authored F083 test's measured (n_theta, eps) at n_theta=10 must land eps<=0.0237 and be QUOTED in the completion record; if the beat-free residual still needs >24 nodes, STOP and escalate (representation choice is wrong, do not brute-force). Contracts/SPEC fragments and the todo.d closure are handled by the post-gate doc-sync/Librarian phase, not a WP.

work_packages.title: Audit & close the unrecorded impl findings; delete the collection-breaking orphan test
work_packages.what: Read-audit the substantially-complete beat-free tube implementation in surrogate.py and surrogate_training.py, close (fix only if a real defect is found) the two unrecorded implementation findings from the first launch, and delete the orphan test file that breaks pytest collection. NO test authoring — every new/changed test is the Test Developer's.
where: cogwheel/lensing/surrogate.py (`_tube_f_ref` ~2953, `_tube_serves` ~3066, `_evaluate_chart` tube branch ~3618-3639, `TUBE_BEAT_FREE_AIRY`/validation ~307/5173/5296), cogwheel/lensing/surrogate_training.py (`_build_tube_chart` ~2973-3053, imports ~66), cogwheel/lensing/surrogate.py `LensAmplificationSurrogate.evaluate` (the `_tube_serves` call site ~3487), cogwheel/tests/test_lensing_tube_nyquist_coordinate.py (DELETE).
work_packages.how: Perform these concrete checks in priority order (Professor + Simplifier ruled). (a) FRAME/t_min CANCELLATION (highest risk): confirm inside `_tube_f_ref` that tau_c = virtual_delay - t_min is subtracted identically from BOTH the envelope carrier and the F_ref uniform-Airy pair, so E and F_ref share one frame and their ratio carries no leftover w-carrier AND no constant off-node phase offset. A constant offset round-trips at build nodes but leaks off-node — verify by tracing that t_min (from `channels._frame_delays`) enters both legs before the ratio, not just one. Do NOT re-derive Delta_tau: it MUST come from the shipped `_merging_fold_pair` import (DRY). (b) ZERO-FILL vs SERVE-None: confirm `_build_tube_chart` zero-fills a refused node (fref is None -> continue, leaving zeros) and that there is NO partial-fill path where one of env/fref is None but the row is left non-zero; confirm `_tube_serves` probes `_tube_f_ref` over the chart's own log_w_grid so a node refused at build is also declined at serve (the serve-side None in `_evaluate_chart` stays an unreachable internal-divergence RuntimeError, never a legitimate return). (c) RAW-SOURCE re-modulation: confirm both `_tube_serves` and `_evaluate_chart` build source_q = np.array([y1_eig, y2_eig]) with NO theta-fold (F_ref is D2-invariant; the theta-fold applies only to the (u,s) residual interpolation). (d) CALLER THREADING (Simplifier-flagged silent-suppression risk): grep `LensAmplificationSurrogate.evaluate` and confirm it threads real y1_eig/y2_eig into the `_tube_serves` call — a default nan would make `_tube_serves` decline every tube chart with NO test failure. (e) PART0 ABSORBER GUARD: confirm the new public module constant `TUBE_BEAT_FREE_AIRY` is imported from `surrogate` at every use site (not re-typed) and cleared against the part0 absorber guard (allowlist-with-justification or production-constant import — the F-sweep DRY precedent). (f) LOBE BYTE-IDENTITY: light confirmation ONLY that no F_ref wiring touches the lobe/wedge/exterior paths (Simplifier TRIM — do not deep-audit; there is no new branch there). Then `git rm cogwheel/tests/test_lensing_tube_nyquist_coordinate.py` (it imports `_tube_delay_map`, `_TUBE_NYQUIST_PPP`, `_TUBE_MIN_THETA_NODES`, `_TUBE_DELAY_MAP_SIZE`, `theta_to_s_prime` — all CONFIRMED absent from the production module; it is superseded-graduation debris, not this build's work; its DRY delay-equality intent is already covered by the beat-free suite). If checks (a)-(e) reveal an actual defect, fix it minimally in place; if they pass, record each as a closed finding in the change report with the file:line evidence. Do NOT run the full test suite (the Inspector does that) and do NOT author or edit any test file other than deleting the orphan.
work_packages.verification: `_tube_f_ref` applies tau_c=virtual_delay-t_min identically to the E and F_ref legs (frame cancellation holds off-node, not merely at nodes); Delta_tau is sourced from the shipped `_merging_fold_pair` import with no re-derivation; `_build_tube_chart` zero-fills refused nodes and never defaults F_ref to 1; `_tube_serves` and `_evaluate_chart` re-modulate at the RAW (y1_eig,y2_eig) source and `LensAmplificationSurrogate.evaluate` threads those eigenframe coordinates (not nan) into `_tube_serves`; `TUBE_BEAT_FREE_AIRY` is import-shared and part0-guard-clear; the lobe/wedge/exterior paths carry no F_ref wiring; `test_lensing_tube_nyquist_coordinate.py` is deleted and `pytest --collect-only` on cogwheel/tests no longer raises an ImportError. The change report enumerates each audited check with file:line evidence and states whether it was closed clean or required a fix.

domain_test_descriptions: F083 eps-ACCURACY held-out test (the missing acceptance item; author as a new class e.g. `TubeF083AccuracySweepTestCase` in cogwheel/tests/test_lensing_tube_beat_free.py — this is the eps sweep the existing `TubeArcBuildabilityTestCase` explicitly is NOT). SETUP: gamma=0.4 astroid band; take `_tube_training_arcs(structure, 1)[0]` and TRIM it to a servable sub-arc where `_merging_fold_pair` resolves robustly along the whole run (the full cusp-to-cusp arc has a non-monotone Delta_tau and must not be used) — derive the sub-arc bounds from the live `_merging_fold_pair` boundary, do NOT pin literal thetas. Build a MINIMAL beat-free tube chart on that sub-arc with n_theta=10 build nodes at mid-shell (engine on but small). OPERATION: hold out 8 OFF-node queries whose theta lie strictly BETWEEN the 10 build nodes (node-midpoints, interior interpolation) at eta=0.5*eta_max; serve each through the real surrogate guard stack over w in [40,80]; compute eps = the F_ref-NORMALIZED (NOT |exact_total|-normalized — |exact_total| vanishes at the old q=0 carrier's Airy zeros where F_ref does not, producing false-failure spikes) max relative error of the served E against the Schwinger-engine oracle over held-out points x w. EXPECTED: refused_count==0 on the trimmed run (premise guard — assert it, else the fixture is stale), and eps <= 0.0237 at n_theta=10. The pre-fix beating representation needed ~48 nodes and would fail this at 10, so this is a genuine anti-regression gate, not existence evidence. The test MUST emit its measured (n_theta, eps) pair (log line and/or a saved diagnostic plot of eps vs n_theta) so the completion record can quote it — quoting (nodes, eps) is unconditional acceptance. DIAGNOSTIC: a plot of served |E| vs w at a held-out theta overlaid on the engine oracle would show residual cos(w*Delta_tau) beating if the representation regressed; a plot of eps vs n_theta would show the collapse to the smooth-variation scale. This test's per-run cost: 10 build nodes + 8 held-out x ~a few w each on ONE trimmed sub-arc, single band — seconds, well under the 60s ceiling. If the authored test measures eps > 0.0237 requiring >24 nodes, STOP and escalate rather than raising the node count.

RAW-SOURCE re-modulation spy pin (new, narrow — distinct from D2 output-equality). SETUP: a servable tube query with a source in a NON-fundamental D2 octant (at least one negative eigenframe component). OPERATION: patch/spy the `surrogate._tube_f_ref` binding used by the serve path and capture the `source` argument it is called with during `_evaluate_chart`; also assert the returned F_ref value is actually consumed (E=r*F_ref) rather than discarded. EXPECTED: `_tube_f_ref` is invoked with the RAW eigenframe (y1_eig, y2_eig) — NOT the theta-folded (u,s) coordinate and NOT the fundamental-octant reflection — confirming F_ref is recomputed at the raw D2-invariant source while the theta-fold is applied only to the residual interpolation. DIAGNOSTIC: asserting the captured source equals the raw query source (not its folded image) catches a regression that folds the source before F_ref, which would round-trip at fundamental-octant nodes but silently corrupt off-fundamental serves.

D2-fold suite RECONCILIATION (parsimony contract: RUN FIRST, repoint pins only where red — do NOT rewrite the suite). SETUP/OPERATION: run cogwheel/tests/test_lensing_tube_d2_fold.py against the working tree. EXPECTED: for any test that drifted because the tube chart now stores a beat-free residual r=E/F_ref instead of the raw envelope E, re-point the expectation by RE-DERIVING it from the live production path (e.g. serve the folded and unfolded queries through the real `_evaluate_chart`/`_tube_serves` and assert their D2-equality on the reconstructed physical E), never by deleting an assertion or loosening a tolerance. Keep the D2 F_ref-invariance value pins (F_ref rtol ~1e-11, envelope rtol ~1e-12 per w-node over >=3 non-trivial octants) that already exist in the beat-free suite; the d2_fold suite covers the serve-layer D2 equality and that dual coverage (engine-layer vs serve-layer) is justified — note it, do not triplicate. Any pin still green must be left byte-identical.

NON-VANISHING F_ref guard (confirm/keep the existing pin, do not duplicate): at the old q=0 carrier's Airy zeros xi in {2.338, 4.088, ...}, |F_ref| stays above a small floor (~1e-8 of its typical magnitude) because the q=p reference gives |F_ref|^2 proportional to w^{1/3}Ai^2(-xi)+w^{-1/3}Ai'^2(-xi), which never vanishes by the Airy Wronskian, whereas the shipped q=0 amplitude would vanish there. This invariant guards the representation's core non-division-by-zero property against a future revert to q=0; verify the existing `NonVanishingReferenceTestCase` still asserts it and repoint only if the helper signature changed.

professor_inputs: F083 permanent-test spec CONFIRMED unchanged: n_theta=10 build nodes, 8 off-node held-out at eta=0.5*eta_max (node-midpoints, interior interpolation), w in [40,80], eps <= 0.0237 (the 48-node brute baseline, untightened).

Error currency MUST be F_ref-normalized, NOT |exact_total|-normalized: |exact_total| vanishes at the old q=0 carrier's Airy zeros where F_ref does not, so |exact_total|-normalization would inject false-failure spikes from a vanishing denominator.

gamma=0.045 is a LEGITIMATE build-side refusal band (Delta_tau -> 0 as the fold pair coalesces, so `_merging_fold_pair` has no distinct partner for the uniform-Airy reference); the four-band buildability smoke test must assert 'at least one servable node', NOT 'all servable', and must keep this benign build-side None distinct from the guarded serve-side None (RuntimeError, never a legitimate return).

Highest-risk unrecorded impl finding to audit FIRST: the tau frame cancellation — tau_c=virtual_delay-t_min must be applied identically on both the E and F_ref legs of `_tube_f_ref`; a constant offset round-trips at build nodes but leaks off-node, which is exactly the failure the F083 off-node held-out sweep is designed to catch.

Second/third audit targets: serve must not interpolate across an isolated zero-filled node unflagged (silent r=0); r must be a regular (smooth) interior point at the old q=0 carrier's Airy zeros under the q=p reference.
